claim_boundary: This boundary records a TODO-ledger canonical-gap readiness matrix over the current raw owner-ledger counts and exact duplicate-title groups. It does not claim canonical gap ids, canonical owner assignments, derivative documentation relationships, source or paper anchor mappings, implementation evidence links, cross-document rollup rules, semantic duplicate detection, stale completed duplicate detection, orphaned derivative detection, raw-count inflation reporting, canonical gap completion percentages, or owner review signoff.

criterion_records.ledger_surface: active and completed TODO titles across owner ledgers
criterion_records.missing_readiness: stable canonical underlying-gap ids shared across code, ROADMAP, README, and papers ledgers
criterion_records.validation_gate: canonical gap-id registry with stable ids and owner ledgers
